MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH o, date_part('year', date('2026-10-14')) - date_part('year', date(o.birth_date)) - CASE WHEN date_part('month', date(o.birth_date)) > date_part('month', date('2026-10-14')) OR (date_part('month', date(o.birth_date)) = date_part('month', date('2026-10-14')) AND date_part('day', date(o.birth_date)) > date_part('day', date('2026-10-14'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE age = 65 OR EXISTS { MATCH (o)-[:Owns]->(t:Team) WHERE t.team_name <> 'Indiana Pacers' AND t.team_name <> 'New Orleans Pelicans' }
RETURN DISTINCT o.nationality AS col1, age AS col2, o.name AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
